maximum_depth_rule: All 159 canonical Phase 9 Reviewed statements are retained exactly once with their registered document, PDF location, raw text, tokens, unit, scope, operator, and unresolved comparability boundary.
version_boundary: The 2024 to 2033 vision, overview editions, full edition, basic-goal and reference documents, policy and measure targets, project evaluation, resident sentiment, and prior-plan final evaluation remain separate layers.
non_goals: Do not infer records from the three registered documents with zero reviewed rows.
Do not count overview and full-edition repetitions as independently achieved outcomes.
Do not merge prior-plan final evaluation, resident sentiment, targets, and actuals without reviewed linkage.
Do not calculate policy achievement, causality, or cross-prefecture ranking.
